newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 485.25/486.00/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 485.25/486.00/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer at 485.25/486.00 per dollar ahead of Tuesday's market holiday after the Central Bank mostly stayed away from a quiet session, traders said.
The bolivar closed Friday at 484.80/485.80 per dollar.
The exchange rate rose "because the Central Bank did not satisfy the market's (dollar) needs, even if demand was only light," said one trader.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.
Venezuelan banks and financial markets are closed Tuesday June 24 for the Battle of Carabobo national holiday. They will reopen on Wednesday June 25.
